title: Duplicate payment review
text: A suspected duplicate payment should be escalated to Payment Operations after the transaction IDs and amounts are compared. Do not reverse either transaction until the review is complete.

title: Failed payment status
text: A failed payment remains in review until the processor response code is recorded. The support team can tell the customer that the payment is under review without promising a settlement time.

title: Payment Operations retry procedure
text: Payment Operations may retry a failed payment once after confirming that the processor did not settle it. Record the original transaction ID and the new attempt ID in the case log.

title: Refund requests
text: A refund request must reference the original settled payment. Support should collect the transaction ID and route the request to the refunds queue.

title: Payment Operations reconciliation cutoff
text: Payment Operations starts daily reconciliation after the 18:00 UTC ledger cutoff. Exceptions found after that cutoff enter the next day's review queue.

title: Customer status updates
text: Customer status updates should describe the current review state and the next owner. Do not state that a payment has settled until the processor confirms settlement.
